lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca₄Y₄O₁₀ (reduced formula Ca₂YO₂.₅) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pmn2₁ (No. 31), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca and Y centers each coordinated by six O neighbors, while O centers have three or four geometric neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Ca- and Y-centered 6-vertex coordination polyhedra, and edge-sharing among Ca-centered polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites.
